name: Mabel, Valley Hero
description: A mouse, mother of three, wielder of the sword Cragflame, who saved Valley by returning the egg of the Calamity Beast Maha.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Mabel returns Maha's egg and saves Valley from the stolen egg's consequences.
timeline.quote: When the mercenary Cruelclaw stole the egg of the mighty Calamity Beast Maha, it was Mabel who saved Valley.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
